result:
I ran the 14:00 check. Three FEBio runs are healthy and should finish around 14:15. After that nothing is queued, so the cores and GPUs will sit idle.

- **Running:** a launch script started by hand at 13:56 (tmux `fullnewton2`) started three pilot_rep3 full-Newton extension runs:

  | Run | GPU | Cores | Sim time reached |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | p093n2 | 1 | 54-58 | 3.798 |
  | p093n3 | 3 | 16-21 | 3.861 |
  | p145n | 4 | 112-117 | 3.882 |

  Each run's cores are inside one NUMA node, so the threads won't pile up. All three logs were still being written at 14:00:45.
- **Finished since 13:03:** p093n extension ended normally at 13:18 (1060 s). physio_fric3 p060 ended normally at 13:57 (3463 s).
- **Resources:** load is 15.9 against a 32-core quota, and 17 of those cores are my FEBio runs. Memory is at 134.8 of 137.4 GB, but only 10.4 GB of that is real program memory; the rest is file cache that can be freed. There have been no out-of-memory kills. The /raid disk is 84% full.
- **GPUs:** 1, 3 and 4 are mine. GPU 3 is shared with another user. GPUs 0, 2, 5 and 6 are only used by other users.
- **Queues:** both are empty. The task queue has 0 waiting and 0 running (1 done, 5 failed). The old FEBio queue has 0 waiting and 0 running (2600 done, 2 failed).
- **Services:** every tmux service is up.
- **Idle:** from 13:18 to 13:56 only p060 was running, so about 6 cores went unused.
- **Change:** the three runs from 13:56 weren't covered by the restart recovery script, so I added them to `ops/resume_all.sh`. A run restarts only if it has no `done` file and isn't already running. The syntax check passes, and all three running jobs are recognised, so nothing would start twice.
- **Still blocked:** p093d can't start because its required pre-run check (h24) fails: `window_dt` isn't one of the allowed settings in the h37 list. I didn't bypass it.
- **Needs a person:**
  - The research roles need to queue the next batch so work continues after about 14:15.
  - p093d needs `window_dt` added to the h37 allowed-settings list, or a different variant.

The report is in `work/agents/foreman/report_20261118_1400.md`. I also updated `status.json` and added a line to `foreman_actions.log`.
